verdict.rationale: Ramp claims automatic receipt capture at card swipe and says its agents automate 'collecting receipts'. The open-source CLI exposes receipt upload and attach commands, and the MCP server advertises a receipts:write scope, so receipts can be uploaded and tied to transactions. However, no evidence shows that emailed or uploaded receipts are automatically matched to the correct transaction; the documented attach path appears explicit rather than auto-matched. Missing for 10: an email-forwarding receipt inbox, documented auto-matching of uploaded receipts to transactions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
